title: Scope the Supplier Registry as a health layer over cross-sector identities
requirements:
- Build on authoritative business, tax and procurement identities where available rather than duplicating them
- Support provisional and pending-verification statuses for emergency suppliers
- Make notification of suspension, sanction, licence expiry and recall mandatory for authorised consumers
- Limit content to supplier identity and health-sector qualification; keep contracts and performance in procurement systems
- Verify legal-entity data via authoritative sources rather than revalidating it
- Model typed supplier-product relationships and support diverse supplier forms
- Require source, legal basis, correction and appeal for sanctions or exclusion status
- Qualify claims about preventing counterfeit and corruption
